Full suite run (all `*AgentTest.java` files) also passes cleanly — 23 tests, no failures.

## Summary

I added `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/reflect/MemberUtilsAgentTest.java`, a self-contained JUnit 5 test class covering `MemberUtils`:

- `compareConstructorFit` / `compareMethodFit`: exact match vs. superclass widening, interface-match penalty, primitive promotion ordering, varargs explicit-array vs. generic-match-to-`Object` behavior, and equal-cost ties.
- `isMatchingMethod` / `isMatchingConstructor`: fixed-arity boxing/mismatch/arity cases and varargs (zero, one, multiple elements, mismatched component type).
- `isPublic`, `isStatic`, `isPackage`: including `null` and non-access modifier bits (e.g. `STATIC`).
- `isAccessible`: public non-synthetic method (true), private method (false), and a compiler-generated public bridge method (false — synthetic members aren't "accessible").
- `setAccessibleWorkaround`: `null` input, public method on a package-private class (gets forced accessible), private method on a package-private class (left untouched), public method on an already-public class (left untouched, no workaround needed), and an already-accessible object (returned as-is).

All 23 tests pass, so this suite did not surface a bug in `MemberUtils` — I'm not naming any failing test, since none exists.
